clips.title: The story
paras: Scourge forces press against Stormwind, with necropolises looming beyond its walls. Lieutenant Orrin calls defenders to strike their camps, gather Necrotic Stones, and study the runes there.

Scourge forces have reached the outskirts of Stormwind City. Necropolises float overhead as undead and cultists take hold near the kingdom’s greatest bastion. Lieutenant Orrin gathers defenders outside the city to drive them back before they threaten the capital.

Glowing runes mark the dirt around Scourge camps, and their purpose remains unclear. The circles crackle with magic like that of the necropolises and carry eerie whispers. Lieutenant Orrin can only guess who, if anyone, hears those unnatural voices.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Scourge is camped upon our very doorstep; we cannot remain idle! Surely you will step up to defend Stormwind from these accursed invaders?

There are strange runic circles outside, glowing with the same energy that surrounds the undead and the Necropolis above. They have significance, I'm certain, and I want you to find out what. Thin the numbers of those aberrations while you're at it; bring me proof of their death along with your results, and I will reward you. Go!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you investigated the invasion yet? There's no time for dawdling!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hmm. From what you've told me, the voices within the circles... They must be used for communication of some kind. I shudder to think what unnatural minds are contacted through such magic. Regardless, you seem to have emerged whole and sane. The Argent Dawn appreciates your service.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
